topic: ChatGPT works inside Chrome tabs (Chat and Work modes), Oct 2026

claims.claim: On Oct 15, 2026 OpenAI updated the ChatGPT Chrome extension: Chat mode reads across open tabs (compare products, summarize); Work mode can control tabs to fill forms, send messages, download files and group tabs.

sources.title: OpenAI rolls out major Chrome extension upgrade with tab control and browser automation
ChatGPT becomes a full Chrome browser assistant
ChatGPT takes on Google Gemini in Chrome

claims.claim: Official setup: in the ChatGPT desktop app open Settings > Computer Use, select the browser, install the extension from its store page, confirm it shows Manage, then start a Work or Codex chat and @-mention the browser.
By default ChatGPT asks before it interacts with each new website (Allow once / Allow for this site / Allow for all sites / Decline); browser history always needs a prompt.
The Chrome Web Store listing 'ChatGPT' is published by OpenAI, has 7,000,000 users, version 1.26.1005.11759, updated Oct 15, 2026; lookalike 'ChatGPT' extensions from other publishers exist.

Plan access is reported inconsistently: some outlets say all plans; PiunikaWeb says Work mode needs at least Plus. OpenAI docs say availability depends on rollout and workspace settings. Do not state plan access on screen.
